title: Symbol-to-word learning and supplied-rule composition
researchQuestions: Can explicitly taught symbols and words be recognized, retrieved, and traced to their teaching experiences?
Can a supplied composition rule apply learned vocabulary to held-out combinations?
Can the system abstain on unknown, ambiguous, or role-unsupported inputs?
Do learned mappings, corrections, reversals, persistence, and reset behave as specified?

hypotheses.prediction: Trained condition B and C retrieve explicitly taught symbols and words with higher exact accuracy than empty condition A.
hypotheses.measurement: Held-out symbol recognition, symbol-to-concept, and word-to-concept accuracy.

hypotheses.prediction: The condition with composition distinguishes previously shown example usage from unseen combinations without storing complete test utterances.
hypotheses.measurement: Separate exact accuracy for four shown usages and twenty unseen known-word combinations.

hypotheses.prediction: With identical vocabulary facts, supplied-rule condition C composes unseen known-word combinations more accurately than retrieval-only condition B.
hypotheses.measurement: Matched B-versus-C accuracy on the twenty unseen combinations.

hypotheses.prediction: Unknown, candidate-ambiguous, and role-unsupported cases abstain rather than inventing a supported concept or frame.
hypotheses.measurement: Unknown rejection, ambiguity handling, and unsupported inference rates.

hypotheses.prediction: Accepted associations survive a separate process reload and become unavailable after resetting their isolated store.
Feedback correction changes the targeted association, retains unrelated associations, and is reversible.
hypotheses.measurement: Conflict rejection, correction, unrelated probes, revision history, and revert.

hypothesisStatus: Predictions are tested and reported in results-003.json; outcomes are limited to this synthetic fixture.

conditions.A: Empty isolated TransInfant store; association retrieval and composition disabled.
conditions.B: Explicitly taught associations; exact lookup enabled, composition disabled.
conditions.C: Same explicitly taught associations as B; exact lookup and the supplied three-token rule enabled.

compositionRule.description: Compose one known entity, one known predicate, and one known entity in order. This rule is supplied; it is not learned or induced.

metricDefinitions.symbolRecognitionAccuracy: Correctly recognized symbol inputs divided by symbol-recognition examples; does not score their meaning.
metricDefinitions.symbolToConceptAccuracy: Exact accepted target concept ID divided by symbol-to-concept queries.
metricDefinitions.wordToConceptAccuracy: Exact accepted target concept ID divided by word-to-concept queries.
metricDefinitions.compositionAccuracy: Exact expected output slot IDs and supported status divided by composition examples.
metricDefinitions.unknownRejectionAccuracy: Queries for untaught words correctly returned unknown divided by unknown-word examples.
metricDefinitions.ambiguityHandlingAccuracy: Ambiguous cases correctly abstained with ambiguous status divided by ambiguity examples.
metricDefinitions.unsupportedInferenceRate: Composition outputs asserted despite an unfulfilled role or missing rule divided by unsupported examples.
metricDefinitions.persistenceAccuracy: Exact concept/status retrieval after a separate process reload divided by persistence probes.
metricDefinitions.resetVerification: Count of previously known probes returning unknown after resetting the isolated store.
metricDefinitions.duplicateHandlingCorrectness: Whether duplicate teaching adds no second accepted relation for the same input and target.
metricDefinitions.latency: Per-query wall-clock latency; descriptive nearest-rank p50/p95 across measured query observations; no significance inference.
